title: Sorrentino 2021 · Ageing and avatar adjustment
citation: Sorrentino et al. (2021). How ageing shapes body and space representations: A comparison study between healthy young and older adults. Cortex, 136, 56–76.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.display: Show an age- and gender-matched MakeHuman-derived avatar in a diagonal third-person perspective on a 52 by 32 cm monitor. A white cloth conceals participant shoulders, arms and hands.
published_method.response: The displayed dimension starts at the assigned extreme. Participant verbally instructs the experimenter to adjust the shape through the custom keyboard interface until the dimension appears to match their body.
published_method.scoring: Record the confirmed dimension as a ratio to the age- and gender-matched reference avatar value of 1. Compute normalized width divided by normalized length for the shape index.
published_method.software_scope: The 16-cell factorial and ratio scoring are specified. Original avatar files, reference-population parameter mappings, starting scale extremes and keyboard increments are unresolved.

stimulus_type.value: Age- and gender-matched visual avatar with adjustable upper-limb dimensions

implementation_gaps: Requires a visual avatar renderer with individually adjustable dimensions, continuous value capture and operator controls. Study-specific original reference avatar parameters, deformation increment and initial scale ranges are unavailable.
The physically matched display and viewing setup still require verification.
